lock_notes.market: Market-direction alignment: the regime method AND every parameter (opening range, Fib ratios, VWAP source, swing return threshold and structure rule).
lock_notes.sector: Qualifying-sector selection: absolute and relative tests, coverage, top N.

hard_constraints.shared_limits_from: the portfolio base config (futures_config.json): max open positions, notional, margin, daily loss, one position per underlying
hard_constraints.note: Never part of a strategy definition; compile_config always takes them from the portfolio and research cannot change them.

permissions.research_and_shadow: any valid strategy, including ones that need lock changes (shown as proposals)
permissions.activation: explicit user approval of the exact version + evidence snapshot; lock changes need their own explicit approval
permissions.automatic_pause: entries may be paused automatically for operational or hard-risk failures; monitoring and exits continue

cadence.note: Counts completed exchange sessions, not calendar days. A poorly covered session still counts and still gets a data-quality report; its evaluations are labelled incomplete.

search.note: anthropic_web = Claude's server-side web_search tool (web_search_20260209); fixture = offline test data, always labelled FIXTURE; more providers plug into sf_research.SEARCH_PROVIDERS

llm.note: extracts testable rules from retrieved text with structured output; retrieved text is untrusted data

calculation_minimums.note: Below these a metric is not computed at all (it is undefined, shown as such).

labels.note: Labels only. They never gate scheduling or research; activation needs your approval whatever the label.
labels.INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 5 settled trades in historical replay AND fewer than 3 forward sessions
labels.EVALUATED: at least 15 replay sessions with 20+ settled trades, or 15+ forward shadow sessions with 20+ settled trades
